messages:
maya: hey team — first day here! running into a couple setup snags: Okta invite wants me to enroll a Passkey but on Ubuntu 22.04 I get ‘no platform authenticator’ in the browser. Tried Chrome & Firefox. Also didn’t get my 1Password invite and I can’t see the onboarding Google Drive folder. who should I ping?

samir-it: hey @maya, welcome! for linux the common flows are: 1) use the Okta mobile cross-device passkey flow, or 2) register a hardware key (YubiKey). Quick thing to try: use Chrome stable and the mobile flow. I'll open a ticket and we can enable a fallback while we fix enrollment.

samir-it: if you want to try the chrome flag (not ideal long-term): `chrome://flags/#enable-webauthn` — enable platform authenticator. But honestly mobile is easiest: on desktop click ‘Use your phone’ in Okta and follow the QR.

maya: ok trying mobile now — thanks. any idea when 1Password & Drive will be provisioned? need the onboarding doc for the afternoon.

ayana: @maya I just assigned a Google Workspace license for your account and resent the 1Password invite to maya@redwood.com. check spam/junk — the invite has a one-time link. I’ll escalate if you don’t see it in 10.

it-bot: Ticket #IT-4821 created and assigned to samir-it. Temporary fallback access (password + MFA) queued. ETA ~2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir-it: @maya quick note — when you scan the QR from mobile you should get a confirmation screen on desktop. If mobile flow fails, reply here and I’ll enable fallback and we can register a hardware key in person.

john-admin: confirmed I updated Drive perms — you should have Viewer on /Onboarding/Engineering; if you need Editor let me know and I’ll bump it.

maya: mobile passkey flow worked! also found 1Password invite in spam folder. thank you all. quick question re: 1Password org recovery — should I add a personal recovery key?

ayana: glad it worked. for org accounts, use the company vaults and follow the invite flow. you don’t need to create a personal recovery key for org access — we keep org recovery enabled. only create a personal recovery if you want to use a personal vault tied to a non-work email.

samir-it: :thumbsup: I’ll close the temporary access once you confirm Slack/GDrive/1Password all work for you. @maya can you confirm by EOD?

maya: confirmed — Slack, Drive, and 1Password all good. thanks everyone :tada:
